changeSet.sql: insert into WORKSPACE_SETTINGS( WORKSPACE_ID, SETTING_TYPE, CONFIG, STATUS, USER_ID) select w.id, 'CompactDataTables', '{"enabled": true, "performMigration": false}', 'Applied', 'quicksilver-migration' from WORKSPACE w where w.WORKSPACE_VERSION = 'v2' and (w.ID not in ( select s.WORKSPACE_ID from WORKSPACE_SETTINGS s where s.SETTING_TYPE = 'CompactDataTables' )) and not exists ( SELECT 1 FROM ENTITY e WHERE e.workspace_id = w.id );
